thread:
kevin: Heads-up: coordinated release planned Thu 01:00-04:00 UTC. We're doing router prewarm -> runtime canary -> api roll -> console patch. Need handshake, rollback play, and who watches which metric.

sara: Why router first? to prewarm routes and reduce mid-roll 503s. Agree keep kernel knobs static.

vikram: pin/fallback matrix: router v2.3 (rollback v2.2), runtime v6.1 (fallback v6.0), api v2.25 -> fallback v2.24, console behind flag.

margo: canaries: router 0.5%->5%->25%->100%; runtime 1%->10%->50%->full. console stays at 10% until router full.

deploybot: PRECHECK: config-lock OK; schema-compat WARN (console optional telemetry field); dep-matrix OK; infra-headroom OK.

vikram: console flag will ignore optional field, add client guard. Also bump router cache TTL to 30m for the ramp window to avoid eviction storms.

kevin: rollback lattice: if runtime health < 94% for 4m -> rollback runtime to v6.0 and route traffic to stable pool; if api error-rate > 1.8% for 3m -> pin api to 2.24 and pause runtime progression; if router header-swap failures > 0.5% -> rollback router to 2.2 and restore old route table.

opsbot: ALERTS FOR WINDOW: error-rate >1.5% for 4m -> page #platform-oncall; p50 latency +40% for 5m -> notify #infra; runtime OOM >=3 in 10m -> auto-rollback runtime.

sara: add manual abort: any CS-reported customer outage -> immediate pause and full rollback to last-stable pinned across services.

margo: runbook snippets:
# rollback runtime to v6.0
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version 6.0 --reason "health trigger"
# pin api back to 2.24
deploybot pin --service api --version 2.24 --note "emergency pin"
# router rollback to 2.2
deploybot rollback --service router --to-version 2.2 --note "header-swap fail"

vikram: rehearsals in staging scheduled today. 15m soak between waves.

deploybot: SCHEDULE: dry-run canary 00:50 UTC; wave1 router 01:00; wave2 runtime 01:20; wave3 api 02:00; wave4 console 03:00.

kevin: ack. I'll watch API 5xx and request error rate for first 30m.

sara: ack. monitoring runtime evictions, OOMs, and CPU.

margo: ack. watching router cache-hit, header-swap metrics, and client 1xx/3xx flaps.

opsbot: REMINDER: quiet-window 01:00-04:00 UTC. Non-critical merges blocked.

kevin: thanks team, posting runbook link and handing to oncall. Ending thread.
